payload.body: You tend to resist a role, teacher, or path when accepting it feels like giving someone else the final word. The refusal may protect something real, but it can also keep the future organized around the authority you are trying to escape. Underneath is often the belief that receiving guidance means surrendering choice. Decide which part of the opportunity is useful before rejecting the person who offered it.
payload.astroHint: Lilith square the North Node can make a new opportunity reactivate an old conflict about who gets to decide your direction.
